title: Lead Developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Lead Developer

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

In this role, you will work within a scrum team to bring the designs and ideas to life for new or improved web applications. This work will support a mix of internal and external clients. You will work with clients, product managers, architects, software engineers, and more to plan, design, develop, test, and implement impactful solutions that support companies with one to millions of employees.

You will start your day on a scrum call to prioritize and track work. Within the team you work on, you will choose user stories to work within a sprint cycle. You will spend most of your day developing and testing your code. Every three weeks, you will be involved in the release activities.

Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location.

To thrive in this development career, you'll need to be an expert in:

  • Strong Java developer with REST API, spring and Spring-boot development experience;
  • Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
  • Experience in writing JUNITs for coverage;
  • Experience writing SQL queries and understanding ORM;
  • Good understanding of Jenkins pipelines and CI/CD process;
  • Nice to have experience working with Terraform as IaaC;
  • Advanced English;

As a Lead Developer, you will work closely with your team to lead and guide projects to success. You'll have a hands-on role designing, developing, debugging, and deploying software solutions where you can leverage your expertise with code complexities. You'll also serve as a mentor to the junior developers. In the senior role, you will balance the assigning of user stories through prioritization and consideration of the technical interests of each developer on the team. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry. Pace should not scare you. We still find time for a healthy dose of fun.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

You'll start each day with a scrum, working in a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities while choosing user stories to complete. You will also participate in other agile ceremonies, including scheduled sprint demos, where you will present your work to up to 90 stakeholders.

Build teams that thrive. As an experienced leader, you want everyone to shine. You'll start each day by checking in with your engineering team to identify priorities and challenges. You'll find a way to make the team's day go smoother. You are constantly looking for ways to share your knowledge, motivate others and keep everyone engaged and productive.

Build Products. You will use your technical expertise to review your team's work and help your people excel in an Agile environment. You're proactive and hands-on. When you see a potential issue, you never leave things hanging and unfinished. When you and your team deliver a finished product, it's as polished as you could make it.

Variety of work. There is no typical day. You could be checking in with a team in India one minute, meeting with leadership to review initiatives for the coming quarter later and tomorrow handling a few ad hoc requests from your peers in other departments.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.

Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.

Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.

Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.

Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.

Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

title: Fraud Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Nice to have

  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação ( PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.

O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Projeto: Quintana Analytics - fase III

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Inovação, ciência e sustentabilidade fazem parte da essência do Grupo Boticário, e você pode integrar essa evolução por meio do Quintana Lab. Estamos em busca de um talento analítico e curioso, com paixão por pesquisa e desenvolvimento, para atuar na construção de um conhecimento proprietário sobre ingredientes naturais aplicados à indústria cosmética.

O projeto envolve o estudo cromatográfico de extratos naturais, o desenvolvimento e aplicação de métodos para identificação e quantificação de compostos fitoquímicos, além da proposição e validação de metodologias analíticas que ampliem a precisão e a confiabilidade dos processos laboratoriais.

O objetivo é consolidar práticas robustas, documentadas e replicáveis, fortalecendo a base científica por trás dos futuros ingredientes naturais da empresa.

Se você deseja contribuir para soluções que conectam ciência, inovação e sustentabilidade, impulsionando a criação de ingredientes exclusivos e reforçando o posicionamento inovador do Grupo Boticário, essa oportunidade é para você.

.

Formação Acadêmica: Mestrado em Química, Química Industrial, Farmácia, Biotecnologia, Engenharia Química ou áreas afins.

Principais Atividades:

  • Levantamento bibliográfico de metodologias analíticas e compostos fitoquímicos descritos na literatura.
  • Estudo e aplicação de técnicas analíticas para caracterização de extratos naturais.
  • Execução de experimentos de caracterização cromatográfica, incluindo:
  • Cromatografia líquida: LC-DAD , LC-MS , LC-FLR .
  • Cromatografia gasosa: GC-FID , GC-MS .
  • Screening de tecnologias para caracterização de diferentes ativos vegetais.
  • Preparo de amostras e execução de experimentos analíticos.
  • Avaliação aprofundada da composição fitoquímica de ativos vegetais por meio de técnicas avançadas.
  • Apoio no desenvolvimento de metodologias cromatográficas preparativas, obtenção de frações enriquecidas e aplicação em produtos naturais.
  • Aplicação de métodos farmacopeicos para identificação e quantificação de produtos naturais.

Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Formação em Química, Química Industrial, Farmácia, Biotecnologia, Engenharia Química ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento ou atuação prévia em linhas de pesquisa como: fitoquímica, caracterização fitoquímica, química analítica de produtos naturais, botânica, farmacognosia ou biotecnologia.
  • Familiaridade com preparo de amostras, extração de compostos naturais e execução de análises qualitativas e quantitativas.
  • Capacidade de interpretar dados analíticos complexos e correlacionar composição fitoquímica com propriedades dos extratos.
  • Conhecimento em métodos farmacopeicos para identificação e quantificação de produtos naturais.
  • Noções de desenvolvimento de metodologias analíticas e validação de métodos.

Conhecimentos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com técnicas cromatográficas, incluindo LC-DAD, LC-MS, LC-FLR, GC-FID e GC-MS.

Soft Skills: Administração do tempo, agilidade, atenção, comprometimento, comunicação, criatividade, determinação, disciplina, disponibilidade, espírito de equipe, flexibilidade, inovação, negociação, objetividade, organização, persistência, planejamento, proatividade, relacionamento interpessoal, rendimento sob pressão, resiliência.

Pelo 7º ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025 , da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!

Siga nossa página aqui no LinkedIn e fique por dentro de nossas oportunidades de carreira.

Venha fazer parte da Seguros Unimed e ter uma Jornada Incrível conosco!

O que oferecemos nessa Jornada:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Vale transporte ou estacionamento conveniado;
  • Seguro Saúde;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Garantia Funeral;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Gympass e Totalpass;
  • Happy Day - um dia de folga no aniversário.

Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento Profissional;
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Inovador;
  • Oportunidades de Crescimento na Organização;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.

No seu dia-a-dia :

  • Atuar nas atividades de pequena, média e alta complexidade para prospectar profissionais médicos, clinicas, através de visitas, apresentando vantagens e propostas de atração, visando o credenciamento para atendimento aos clientes, e aumento da utilização da rede credenciada;
  • Realizar a prospecção, implantação, manutenção e expansão da rede credenciada, analisando custos e garantindo a qualidade do serviço prestado, atuando com autonomia;
  • Descrever o processo de credenciamento de prestadores de serviço de atenção domiciliar, Retaguarda e Atenção Primária à Saúde, bem como elaborar relatórios e demonstrativos diversos da área, levantar e compilar dados, calcular e apurar valores, preenchendo
  • planilhas, visando disponibilizar informações gerenciais para a análise e tomada de decisão. Negociar com os novos credenciamentos a aplicação e padronização e referente as tabelas utilizadas pela companhia;
  • Realizar reuniões com as operadoras de serviço de atenção domiciliar para a análise de contratos, reajustes, aditivos de contratos, prestar suporte aos prestadores implantados, bem como orientar os novos prestadores sobre a rotina de faturamento, encaminhamentos e autorizações da operadora;
  • Monitorar o atendimento das cláusulas contratuais e índices da Agência Nacional da Saúde (ANS), através de reuniões para renegociações de reajustes e readequação de contratos;
  • Atender solicitações das Unimeds, direcionar as demandas às áreas pertinentes quando necessário, acompanhar e finalizar as resoluções;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as informações referentes ao negócio, bem como sobre projetos de expansão, legislação, concorrentes, clientes (operadora, médicos, clinicas, operadoras, etc.) e novas oportunidades;
  • Elaborar simulações de impacto financeiro com base nas solicitações de reajuste das Unimeds para renovação contratual;
  • Assessorar a Diretoria, a Superintendência, a Gerência nas demandas de relacionamento com
  • as Unimeds (custos, indicadores, reuniões). Parametrizar sistema interno com as regras contratuais e tabelas de pagamentos negociadas;
  • Manter constante contato com a área comercial, visando conhecer os novos negócios e ampliação dos atuais contratos, atuando proativamente na ampliação da rede de
  • credenciamento;
  • Pesquisar a abertura de novas unidades aos clientes, e/ou novos contratos em andamento e providenciar a rede credenciada necessária para atendimento, bem como manter a interface com a área de credenciamento para auxiliar no processo do credenciamento, e envio da documentação para credenciamento dos prestadores;
  • Verificar e analisar as cidades e municípios circunvizinhos, verificando a capacidade e disponibilidade de credenciamentos, visando o atendimento aos clientes e expansão nos negócios, e a partir desta análise elaborar credenciamento com as operadoras de serviço de atenção domiciliar.

Esperamos de você :

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Pacote office intermédiário;
  • Experiência com credenciamento de rede ambulatorial;

Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro/RJ;
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente on-line nas etapas iniciais.

A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

title: Assistente de Vendas Intermitente | ZARA
description:
A loja é ritmo, decisão e equipe.

É onde as coisas acontecem, onde se vive a moda e onde cada pessoa contribui.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Quer fazer parte da maior rede de construção a seco do Pais?

  • Garantir que a equipe de vendas cumpra as metas e objetivos estabelecido;
  • Resolver conflitos internos e externos de maneira eficaz;
  • Manter uma comunicação eficaz com outros departamentos para garantir a entrega adequada de produtos e serviços.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Gestão Comercial e outras áreas correlatas;
  • Arquitetura, Engenharia Civil serão consideradas um diferencial;
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas CAD e Leitura e Interpretação de Projetos;
  • Experiência com CRM (Bitrix será um diferencial), será indispensável o registro integral da gestão de carteira;
  • Experiência comercial no varejo, preferencialmente na construção civil, móveis planejados e desejável a experiência em construção seca;
  • Experiência no ramo imobiliário, construtoras, incorporadoras, corretoras de imóveis;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas digitais básicas;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Capacidade Analítica;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Possuir habilitação. (B)

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Salario Fixo + Comissão

Pacote de Benefícios:

Vale Refeição;

Plano odontológico;

Plano de Saúde;

Seguro de Vida;

Vale Transporte;

Universidade Espaço Smart;

Kit Maternidade;

MISSÃO, VISÃO & VALORES

Missão

Nascemos com uma missão de transformar a construção civil brasileira, comercializando produtos e serviços que promovem a industrialização e sustentabilidade na construção civil.

Visão

“Ser a MAIOR e a MELHOR empresa de materiais de construção especializada no fornecimento de produtos e serviços para sistemas construtivos industrializados, sustentáveis e inteligentes com atuação Nacional.”

Valores

Sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental;

Integridade com todos os públicos;

Foco em resultados;

Excelência com simplicidade;

Pessoas respeitadas, comprometidas e realizadas;

Segurança das pessoas acima de tudo;

Foco no cliente.

title: Desenvolvedor No Code
description:
Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor No Code para atuar na criação, automação e integração de processos digitais utilizando plataformas de desenvolvimento sem código.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações utilizando plataformas no code/low code (ex: Make, Pipefy, Zapier, Airtable, Power Apps, Bubble etc.);
  • Mapear e automatizar fluxos de processos internos, garantindo escalabilidade e integração entre sistemas;
  • Criar dashboards, formulários, automações e integrações entre ferramentas internas e externas (APIs, ERPs, CRMs, entre outras);
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender demandas, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em soluções tecnológicas simples e eficazes;
  • Documentar fluxos, automações e integrações realizadas;
  • Testar e garantir a estabilidade das soluções implementadas.

  • Experiência prévia com plataformas no code ou low code (Make, Zapier, Pipefy, Power Automate, Airtable, Notion, Bubble etc.);
  • Conhecimento básico em APIs REST , integrações e webhooks ;
  • Capacidade de análise lógica e resolução de problemas;
  • Experiência com automação de processos ou otimização operacional ;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para traduzir necessidades técnicas e de negócio.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service);
  • Conhecimentos básicos em HTML, JavaScript ou Python ;
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) ;
  • Experiência prévia no segmento financeiro ou corporativo .

Local e Modelo de Trabalho

  • Local: São Paulo/SP - Híbrido 3x na semana
  • Modelo de contração: PJ + benefícios

title: Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho
description:

Vaga também para PCDS

Sobre a empresa:

A Minalba Brasil é a divisão de alimentos e bebidas do Grupo Edson Queiroz (GEQ), um dos maiores conglomerados empresariais do país, que se faz presente nos mais diversos momentos da vida dos brasileiros por meio de um portfólio diversificado de marcas e produtos de segmentos variados. A empresa é líder de água mineral no Brasil e detentora das marcas Indaiá, Minalba, São Lourenço, Petrópolis, Refri, Citrus e do energético Night Power. title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Contatóloga(o)
description:
Vision One é uma empresa que cuida da saúde ocular do paciente em todas as etapas da sua jornada.

Somos uma rede nacional que integra hospitais e clínicas especializadas em oftalmologia, unidades ópticas e um robusto Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC), oferecendo excelência médica, soluções personalizadas e gestão eficiente.

Nascemos do desejo genuíno de médicos e fundadores dos mais respeitados hospitais de olhos do país de construir uma empresa forte, líder e inspiradora, com foco em qualidade, humanização, valorização médica e os mais altos padrões de cuidado.

Com atuação integrada e visão de longo prazo, a Vision One promove saúde ocular com responsabilidade, inovação e compromisso com o bem-estar dos pacientes.

E o que move nossa cultura é o CUIDAR .

C orretos

U nidos

I nclusivos

D edicados

Á geis

R esolutivos

Somos um time em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá muitos desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará em nosso Centro de Adaptação de Lentes de Contato , ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial.

Principais responsabilidades

- Atendimento ao Paciente; adaptação de Lentes de Contato e relacionamento médico;

- Treinar novos usuários, para a correta utilização das Lentes de Contato;

- Registrar, em prontuário, os testes realizados e lentes adaptadas;

- Encomendar as lentes com os fornecedores;

- Registrar as Lentes utilizadas no serviço de adaptação, na conta paciente, para controle de saída de estoque;

- Controlar prazos de recebimentos e avisar os pacientes da chega das lentes;

- Dar entrada nas notas fiscais recebidas dos fornecedores, para controle de estoque;

- Registrar, em sistema, Lote e Validade dos produtos, para rastreamento das lentes;

- Receber do Paciente os valores referentes ao Serviço, registrar em sistema, para compor o caixa da Unidade;

- Finalizar o caixa da unidade, conferir e enviar ao financeiro, diariamente;

- Realizar contagens e conferências de estoque, sempre que solicitado;

- Fazer reposições dos testes utilizados, de acordo com a política de cada fornecedor;

- Receber, organizar e armazenar os testes solicitados;

- Manter, em boas condições, as lentes das caixas de prova e, em caso de lentes com avarias, solicitar troca com os fornecedores;

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Senior Lead Technology Architect
description:
DP is hiring a Senior Lead Technology Architect

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

IMPORTANT: Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location, It is necessary to live nearby.

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you will be the person who keeps our team on track and on time for new projects. Working alongside 7 to 14 team members, you remove roadblocks and keep developers coding. Whether it's coaching, cutting meetings short, or auditing the process - you'll do whatever it takes to keep the project moving.

To thrive in this role, you must understand the software development project lifecycle in an Agile environment have prior project management experience working in scrums or as a scrum master. Ideally, you've managed a project from inception to production at an enterprise level. Our best project managers show initiative, try new things and learn from their mistakes along the way. PMP certification is not required. You must be comfortable enough with code to decipher functions, and a technical coding background will help you be successful. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Scrums. You'll start each day with a scrum, working with a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities;
  • Coding. Working in two-week agile sprints, you must keep up with timelines and coding standards. Although your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time, you may need to dive in to review code, so your coding background will come in handy and contribute to your success;
  • Communications. You're the point of contact for the project. You'll share information with your teammates, mark milestones, and provide metrics and status updates to product owners and project sponsors;
  • Organization. As a project manager, you are very organized, and you keep everyone on task. Is a meeting going off-topic? You'll pull the team back to the agenda. Scope creeping? You'll stay on top of the schedule, remove barriers, identify dependencies, and mitigate risks;
  • Variety of tasks. There is no typical day. You could coach a teammate, deliver a status update to executives in other departments, or make sure we have deployed our resources in the best possible way. You will manage many competing priorities, so a fast pace should not scare you. You pride yourself on having flexibility and agility and can change directions without a second thought;
  • Servant Leadership. Your job is to help everyone else work better. What tasks or issues can you handle so your development team can keep working? What barriers can you remove?;

WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

Experience and Skills:

  • Solid experience in leading & managing multiple complex projects in agile environments (both Scrum and Kanban);
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills and be able to communicate and adapt effectively to different audiences (team, management, executive, business etc);
  • Project & Process Management skills, including industry standard project management;
  • Experience in Project Management Tools such as Jira, MS SharePoint, Webex and MS Office & Project;
  • Experience working with offshore teams and project teams distributed across multiple time zones;
  • Strong knowledge of Flutter, React or Stencil.JS
  • Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
  • Experience in the frontend environment
  • Advanced English;
  • Proven experience dealing with challenging team members / personnel issues. On occasion you will be co-managing team members when managers are either remote (other countries) or are not directly involved in the project;
  • Excellent presentation skills and be able to present project updates in front of small or large groups. Be very competent using tools such as MS PowerPoint;

Education:

  • Degree or equivalent in Computer Sciences or related field: A university degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job;
  • PMP certified or equivalent - exceptional foundation project management skills. Must be able to demonstrate a full understanding of the product development and release management life cycles;
  • Certified Scrum Master - be able to demonstrate and show previous experience running agile project teams.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:

A empresa oferece soluções avançadas de negociação, concedendo acesso a uma ampla gama de classes de ativos, incluindo Forex, Commodities, Índices, Ações e Contratos por Diferença (CFDs), todos perfeitamente integrados em uma sofisticada estrutura de negociação com margem cruzada.

Descrição da vaga:

A Stonefort está buscando um Gerente Regional de Vendas altamente qualificado para o Brasil, com profundo conhecimento em CFDs (Contratos por Diferença), para integrar nossa equipe em expansão. O candidato ideal deve possuir uma carteira de clientes sólida, experiência em mercados financeiros, histórico comprovado em vendas e a capacidade de desenvolver e manter relacionamentos fortes com os clientes.

Principais responsabilidades:

Gerar leads e convertê-los em clientes ativos de negociação.

Atingir os KPIs e metas estabelecidos mensal e trimestralmente.

Promover produtos e serviços de negociação de CFDs para clientes de varejo e institucionais. Esteja ativamente alinhado com as tendências atuais do mercado para atrair clientes potenciais. Construa e mantenha relacionamentos sólidos com indivíduos de alto patrimônio e traders.

Uma carteira de clientes ativa e uma forte conexão com o mercado são um diferencial.

Trabalhe internamente com os departamentos relevantes para proporcionar a melhor experiência de integração.

Mantenha-se atualizado sobre os riscos e benefícios da negociação de CFDs para garantir a conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios.

Trabalhe em estreita colaboração com as equipes de marketing e trading para alinhar as estratégias de vendas às tendências do mercado.

Assegure a retenção de clientes por meio de um excelente atendimento ao cliente e gestão de relacionamento.

Mantenha-se atualizado sobre os mercados financeiros, plataformas de negociação e ofertas da concorrência.

Requisitos principais:

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em vendas de negociação de CFDs, forex ou mercados financeiros equivalentes.

Histórico comprovado de atingimento de metas de vendas.

Sólido conhecimento de plataformas de negociação, negociação com margem, alavancagem e gestão de riscos.

Fluência em inglês.

Familiaridade com todas as regulamentações e conformidade do mercado financeiro é um diferencial.

Experiência prática no uso de sistemas CRM, plataformas de negociação (MatchTrader, MT4, MT5) e ferramentas de gestão de leads.

Por que se juntar a nós?

Salário competitivo com estrutura de comissões e incentivos baseados em desempenho.

Oportunidade de trabalhar em um ambiente financeiro dinâmico e de ritmo acelerado.

Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional, treinamento e crescimento na carreira.

Representar a Stonefort em plataformas globais.

About Us:

Stonefort Securities is a distinguished provider in the international financial services sector. With an established presence in the UAE, Mauritius, SVG. Stonefort Securities is well-positioned to meet the dynamic needs of its global clientele. The company offers advanced trading solutions, granting access to a wide range of asset classes including Forex, Commodities, Indices, Stocks and Contracts for Difference (CFDs), all seamlessly integrated within a sophisticated cross-margined trading framework.

Stonefort is looking for a highly skilled Regional Sales Manager - Brazil. with a strong understanding of CFDs (Contracts for Difference) to join our growing team. The ideal candidate must have a strong client book, experience in financial markets, a proven track record in sales, and the ability to develop and maintain strong client relationships.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Generate leads and convert them into active trading clients.
  • Achieve set KPIs and targets; set out on monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Promote CFD trading products and services to retail and institutional clients.
  • Be actively aligned with current market trends to attract potential clients. Build and maintain strong relationships with high-net-worth individuals and traders.
  • Active client base and a strong market connection is an added plus
  • Work internally with relevant departments in order provide best onboarding experience.
  • Stay aligned with the risks and benefits of CFD trading to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with the marketing and trading teams to align sales strategies with market trends.
  • Ensure client retention through excellent customer service and relationship management.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of financial markets, trading platforms, and competitor offerings.

Key Requirements:

  • Minimum of 3 years of sales experience in CFD trading, forex, or financial markets equivalents.
  • Proven track record of achieving sales targets.
  • Strong understanding of trading platforms, margin trading, leverage, and risk management.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Familiarity with all regulations and financial market compliance is a plus.
  • Hands on experience in using CRM systems, trading platforms (MatchTrader, MT4, MT5), and lead management tools.

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive Salary with commission structure and performance-based incentives.
  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic financial environment.
  • Professional development, training, and career growth opportunities.
  • Representing Stonefort at global platforms

title: Analista De Desenvolvimento De Software Junior

title: Senior Art Director
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Location : 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Please submit your resume in English.

We are seeking an Art Director to join our Branding team and play a pivotal role in crafting creative ads and evolving the visual presence of our brand in Brazil. This position is crucial to ensuring that our campaigns are visually striking and culturally resonant, helping us establish a strong foothold in the Brazilian market. If you are passionate about creating captivating visuals and have experience leading high-level creative projects, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the creative visual concepts for entire campaigns, working closely with the content team.
  • Create impactful key visuals that align with the company's marketing strategies.
  • Create high-conversion ad creatives—such as short videos, image-text formats, interactive ads, and H5 pages—based on user psychology, industry trends, and market hot topics.
  • Lead the development and localization of the brand in Brazil, adapting it to the cultural and aesthetic context of the country.
  • Guide and lead other design team members in various projects, ensuring visual consistency and excellence.
  • Design materials for different channels, including digital media, social networks, websites, print materials, and Out Of Home (OOH) media.
  • Manage the creative process from conception to final production, maintaining deadlines and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure visual guidelines align with brand objectives.
  • Stay updated with design trends, technology, and industry innovations, applying relevant insights to projects.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Marketing, Advertising, Visual Design, Journalism, or related fields;
  • Strong business English communication skills;
  • Proven experience as an Art Director or similar role in crafting visual campaigns and key visuals;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing strategic creative skills and visual aesthetics;
  • Experience in leading and mentoring design teams and collaborating with content strategists;
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian culture, aesthetics, and market trends;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in dynamic environments;
  • Proficiency in design software and visual creation tools;
  • Excellent communication skills and a strong ability to work as part of a team.

title: HR Business Partner (individual contributor position)

This is an individual contributor role with a strong execution component — combining hands-on delivery with collaboration and influence across regional and global teams.

Who we are

Zubale is a technology company that enables retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of retailers — from supermarkets, specialty stores, pharmacies, and department stores to fashion brands — across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, and Colombia.

We have three key products:

  1. Flexifleet – Freelancer Marketplace to perform picking, packing, and delivery tasks for retailers and aggregators.
  2. Fulfillment Optimizer – Modular Software to increase productivity in eCommerce picking, packing, and delivery.
  3. Consumer Connect – AI WhatsApp Conversational Commerce to boost sales and elevate customer experience.

We are passionate about helping brands, aggregators, and retailers optimize their eCommerce operations, lower costs, and boost profitability.

Backed by over USD 70 million in venture capital , we’ve delivered consistent growth and completed 100+ million orders through our platform. Today, we serve 100+ customers and engage thousands of freelancers across Latin America — and this is just the beginning.

Who you are

You are a hands-on HR professional who enjoys being close to the business and the people. You combine empathy, structure, and a strong sense of ownership to deliver high-quality results.

You thrive in dynamic environments, balancing operational priorities with thoughtful, people-centered solutions. You’re someone who makes things happen while building trust and collaboration across teams.

  2. Deliver a best-in-class onboarding experience.
  3. Implement surveys, analyze data, and develop action plans to close gaps.

  5. Prepare reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends.

  8. Participate in developing department goals, objectives, and systems.

  10. Own the plan and logistics of internal events.
  11. Implement and sustain People initiatives , ensuring alignment with regional and global priorities.
  12. Manage HR operations and documentation with accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
  13. Work closely with regional people partners to align priorities, localize global programs, and ensure effective implementation in Brazil.

The skills and experience you will bring

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields.
  2. 4+ years of experience in HR, ideally as a Business Partner in fast-paced or tech environments.
  3. Strong understanding of Brazilian labor legislation and HR best practices.
  4. Experience in employee relations, HR operations, and process implementation.
  5. Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  6. Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).
  7. Proactive, collaborative, and detail-oriented, with a genuine interest in helping teams succeed.

title: Finance Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Financial Operations Analyst to join our growing finance team. This role is essential to ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, from end-to-end payment execution and accounting control to tax compliance and audit-ready documentation.

The ideal candidate has a solid background in end-to-end payment processing, a strong understanding of the banking environment, experience with domestic and international transactions (FX payments), and the accounting knowledge required to accurately book and reconcile all financial movements. Additionally, this person will have a solid grasp of withholding tax requirements, the ability to issue service invoices (NFS-e), and a strong focus on internal controls and documentation processes. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment and collaborate closely with teams in Brazil, Singapore, and Japan.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Payment Operations

  • Manage the full accounts payable cycle, including receiving, reviewing, and verifying invoices for accuracy and compliance with company policies.
  • Execute and monitor domestic and foreign currency (FX) payments, including supplier invoices, intercompany transactions, and service fees.
  • Operate banking platforms with accuracy and control, ensuring timely payment execution and proper approval workflows.
  • Track and manage payment terms, proactively resolving discrepancies and maintaining strong supplier relationships.
  • Coordinate with BPO providers and internal stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues and provide regular payment status updates.
  • Review, validate, and process employee reimbursement claims, ensuring policy compliance, complete documentation, and readiness for audits.
  • Support the continuous improvement of payment procedures and contribute to the development of updated policies and standard operating procedures to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Tax and Invoicing

  • Identify, calculate, and control withholding taxes such as IRRF, ISS, PIS/COFINS, and INSS on supplier invoices and service payments.
  • Ensure proper tax treatment and accurate accounting of all transactions, including cross-border payments.
  • Prepare and issue service invoices (NFS-e) for intercompany and third-party transactions in compliance with municipal regulations and internal policies.
  • Support tax reconciliations, documentation, and reporting required for audits and statutory filings.

Accounting, Reporting, and Internal Controls

  • Accurately record, classify, and reconcile all payment transactions in the general ledger, ensuring proper accounting treatment.
  • Support the maintenance of the chart of accounts, including the creation and updating of GL accounts and cost centers.
  • Assist with monthly closing activities and prepare financial reporting packages for submission to the headquarters in Singapore.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by preparing and organizing documentation that meets governance and compliance requirements.
  • Contribute to building and strengthening internal controls, documentation standards, and compliance processes across all payment, accounting, and tax operations.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and professional working proficiency in English (CEFR B2 or above).
  • 2 to 3 years of experience in accounts payable, payment processing, treasury operations, accounting, or similar finance roles, preferably in a multinational environment.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian payment processes, tax obligations, and withholding tax requirements.
  • Proven experience issuing service invoices (NFS-e) and ensuring compliance with fiscal requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with FX payments, international transactions, and corporate banking platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Solid knowledge of internal controls, documentation standards, and audit requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and international teams.

Why Join Us

  • You will be part of a dynamic finance team that plays a strategic role in our company’s expansion and operations in Brazil. This is a unique opportunity to deepen your expertise in payments, accounting, tax compliance, and internal controls while contributing to the growth of a global organization with strong connections to Singapore and Japan.

title: Registration Assistant
description:
Mission of the Role:

Due to growth & expansion of business in Brazil, CAC is looking to hire a seasoned professional who will be responsible for support and accelerate product registration and compliance activities in the Brazilian market , reporting to Registration manager in Brazil. The key objectives for this role are:

  • Managing the submission, follow-up, and maintenance of product registrations in Brazil

description:

6.HR Data & Record Keeping:Maintain up-to-date employee master data, personnel files, and HR databases.Ensure confidentiality and compliance in all HR documentation and system entries.

Qualifications & Requirements:

1.Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

2.Minimum 2 years of hands-on HR experience in a Brazilian company or multinational environment.

3.Solid understanding of Brazilian labor legislation (Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho – CLT).

4.Employee onboarding and offboarding.Employment contract administration.Attendance tracking and timekeeping systems (e.g., TOTVS, Senior, Oracle, etc.).Payroll support and social tax/filing (INSS, FGTS, IRRF)

5.Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable with strong execution skills.

6.Experience in conducting training or employee engagement activities.

7.Fluently English for business communication.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Company Description

RockSpoon is seeking an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our team on-site in São Paulo. In this leadership role, you will craft and oversee user experiences that are exceptionally intuitive, requiring no training or tooltips for users. You will champion a design philosophy that emphasizes clarity, minimalism, and intuitive design thinking to achieve outstanding usability across our product line. Working across our cross-platform suite (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS), you will leverage effective visual hierarchy, layout, and interaction cues to guide users effortlessly. This full-time position involves collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers; you will also mentor team members and shape our design system to deliver an exceptional user experience.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead intuitive UX design: Lead the design of clear, self-explanatory user interfaces and workflows. Leverage visual hierarchy, layout, and intuitive interaction cues to guide users, ensuring the product is so intuitive that no training or tooltips are needed.
  • Product design strategy: Drive the UX/UI design strategy with a strong focus on usability, minimalism, and intuitive design principles. Align design objectives with product goals to deliver a simple, elegant, and highly usable experience for users.
  • Cross-platform oversight: Oversee and contribute to the design of features across mobile and desktop platforms (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS). Ensure a consistent, seamless user experience that respects platform-specific guidelines while maintaining a unified product identity.
  • Design and prototyping: Create detailed wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes in Figma to communicate design concepts. Iterate quickly based on feedback and usability findings to refine the user experience.
  • Design system ownership: Own and evolve RockSpoon’s design system and style guides. Establish UI standards and reusable components that promote a cohesive, intuitive, and minimalist interface across all products.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders: Work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders from concept through launch. Ensure feasibility of designs and a smooth handoff to development, while advocating for the best user experience.
  • Mentorship and leadership: Mentor and provide guidance to mid-level and junior designers. Foster a culture of user-centered, intuitive design thinking within the team through knowledge sharing, code/design reviews, and continuous feedback.
  • User research & testing: Champion user research and usability testing efforts. Plan or participate in user interviews, UI tests, and analytics reviews to validate design decisions, using insights to continuously improve the product’s clarity and ease of use.
  • Usability and accessibility standards: Ensure all designs meet high standards for usability and accessibility. Deliver a frictionless, responsive experience for a diverse user base, and refine interactions to eliminate pain points and confusion.
Qualifications & Skills
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or a similar role, with significant experience leading design projects or initiatives. Proven track record of delivering successful and intuitive digital products or features.
  • Portfolio: An outstanding portfolio showcasing your product design work. Should include examples of complex applications you’ve made simple through intuitive design, demonstrating excellent usability, visual clarity, and minimalistic style.
  • Expert UX/UI knowledge: Deep knowledge of user experience principles and interaction design. Comfortable with information architecture, user flows, and usability heuristics. Ability to simplify complex workflows and create interfaces that feel natural to users.
  • Cross-platform expertise: Extensive experience designing for a range of platforms – native mobile (iOS and Android) and web/desktop applications. Familiarity with the best practices and constraints of each platform, and ability to create cohesive experiences across them.
  • Design tools & systems: Mastery of design and prototyping tools, especially Figma. Strong experience in building or maintaining design systems and component libraries. Able to enforce and evolve a consistent design language at scale.
  • Leadership & collaboration: Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead design discussions, clearly communicate design rationale, and influence product strategy. Experience collaborating in cross-functional teams and working closely with engineering and product management.
  • Intuitive design mindset: Demonstrated intuitive design thinking and problem-solving ability. Passion for usability and minimalism – you instinctively design solutions that feel easy and obvious to the end user, without extraneous complexity.
  • Communication & language: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English (required for daily use). Portuguese language skills are a plus and will be helpful in the local office environment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, HCI, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Spring Health is the leading comprehensive mental health benefit for employers. We help employees understand their mental health issues and connect with best-in-class providers to get the right treatment at the right time.

From early detection to full recovery, Spring Health is the only clinically validated solution in the market proven to be more effective than traditional mental healthcare. We are seeking qualified, part-time internationally licensed psychotherapists to join our provider network and deliver care with a tech-enabled, AI/machine-learning platform that puts patient outcomes first.

What You'll Do

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing as many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.

Who you are

  • You are properly qualified (licensed, if applicable) to practice counseling (as a Psychologist, Psychotherapist, Clinical Psychologist, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring clinical supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure).
  • You have a minimum of 3 years of independent clinical experience.
  • You have access to a computer or laptop, are comfortable with technology, and are tele-health competent.
  • You are available to offer some amount of monthly in-person availability for Spring Health members in Marau.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.

If you are applying to a hybrid role, please be aware that your own office space will be required.

Why you'll like working with Spring Health

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management

Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: UX/UI Designer

About Eightpoint

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.

About the Role

You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design

  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

title: Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur
description:
We’re Hiring!

Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur

At Envu, we partner with our customers to design world-class, forward-thinking innovations that protect and enhance the health of environments around the world. We offer dedicated services in: Professional Pest Management, Forestry, Ornamentals, Golf, Industrial Vegetation Management, Lawn & Landscape, Mosquito Management, and Range & Pasture.

Envu brings together a broad range of perspectives to look beyond chemistry and dare to explore new paths forward. Guided by our inclusive culture, we embrace change and flexibility, tackling our customers’ toughest challenges proactively, passionately and with an entrepreneurial spirit.

We pursue our ambitions collaboratively because we know that a unified and empowered team is an unstoppable force, allowing us to achieve our vision of healthy environments for everyone, everywhere. Join Us.

Envu is proud to be Great Place to Work Certified in the U.S., France and India (June 2025 – June 2026)

FUNCTION : Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur

LOCATION : São Paulo / Brazil

JOB TYPE : Permanent

ROLE SENIORITY : Managerial

GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

Coordinates production with tollers, ensuring alignment with the sales plan, efficient execution, and resolution of conflicts and delays. Plans and manages the availability of materials and active ingredients (AI), executing MRP calculations, purchasing, and logistics coordination with suppliers. Monitors inventory levels, intercompany transfers, and toller performance, supporting continuous improvement in collaboration with supply chain and procurement teams.

YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

  • Owns toller coordination, ensuring production scheduling aligns with sales plan and demand priorities while maintaining adherence to frozen periods and committed production slots
  • Coordinates daily/weekly production plans with tollers, ensuring smooth execution by tracking output, resolving scheduling conflicts, and mitigating production delays. Works closely with the senior supply and planning specialist to align production priorities.
  • Monitors production execution, proactively identifying and addressing issues related to toller capacity, material shortages, or unexpected disruptions. Escalates unresolved risks to supply planning and procurement teams.
  • Owns material planning, ensures material availability of AI, co-formulants, and packaging readiness for planned production runs. Collaborates with suppliers and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Tracks and reports toller inventory levels, working with the Inventory Manager to identify potential shortages, excess stock, or discrepancies at toller sites.
  • Feeds production output data into ERP systems, ensuring visibility of completed batches and enabling accurate intercompany transfer orders, stock movements, and replenishment planning.
  • Collaborates with Logistics & Distribution, ensuring timely execution of intercompany transfers for finished goods and AI. Aligns outbound logistics, transportation planning, and carrier coordination to facilitate seamless material movement.
  • Provides input on toller performance, tracking adherence to schedules, production efficiency, and issue resolution. Supports continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with supply planning and procurement teams.
  • Runs MRP calculations daily/weekly, ensuring accurate material replenishment by validating planning parameters such as lead times, order quantities, and safety stock. Drives improvement in planning accuracy by refining MRP parameters based on supply performance.
  • Updates MRP with supplier feedback, incorporating changes in lead times, production constraints, and delivery schedules to ensure material availability. Works closely with suppliers to proactively adjust for potential delays and optimize material flow.
  • Manages procurement execution, creating and tracking purchase orders for direct materials and AI.
  • Communicates material requirements to suppliers, validating availability against forecasts and ensuring timely deliveries.
  • Coordinates material and AI call-offs, ensuring timely deliveries from suppliers while optimizing logistics flows in collaboration with Distribution & Logistics. Monitors transportation lead times and ensure alignment with toller production schedules.
  • Acts as secondary support as senior supply and planning specialist in Conosur and Brazil according to the business needs.

ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration or related fields;
  • APICS certification strongly recommended;
  • Post-graduation is desired;
  • Project Management skills;
  • 3+ years cumulative experience in Supply Chain Planning & Tollers; Inventory Management;
  • Key competencies | Customer Focus, Teamwork, Drives Results, Analytics, Strategic Thinking and Problem Solving;
  • Assertive Communication, Leadership and influencing skills required;
  • Excellent knowledge of advanced planning principles, strategies, and systems;
  • Required fluent Spanish and English;
  • Availability for travel (15%)

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

By applying for this position, you agree that your personal data are going to be processed and recorded by Envu for recruitment purposes only. For candidates who are not selected for this position, personal data will be kept for a period of two years and then permanently deleted.
